characteristics.$text: Vectored, Resupply and Rearm, Flawed Design
characteristics.name: Special

rules.description:
If this ship ends its movement in base contact with a friendly ship of Medium Tonnage or higher or a Space Station, pick one of the following:
Resupply: That Ship or Space Station recovers 3 Hull points and remove any Crippling Effect tokens.
Rearm: Increase the Limited-X value of any of that Ship or Space Station’s Weapons and Launch Assets by 1 until the end of the round.
rules.name: Resupply and Rearm

rules.description: This Ship cannot use its Resupply and Rearm rule if it is below half of its starting Hull.
rules.name: Flawed Design

characteristics.name: Special
characteristics.$text: Monitor, Reinforced Armour, Feature Carrier (Hanger), Space Trucker

rules.name: Feature Carrier (Hanger)
rules.description: This ship starts the game carrying a single deployable Hangar Feature (see 7.4.2 Deploying Features and 11.3 Features).

conditions.childName: Rare ships when Rare ship limit reached

rules.description: This Ship starts the game carrying a Military Outpost as a Deployable Feature.
rules.name: Feature Carrier (Outpost)

rules.description:
This weapon can only be used against targets within Scan range and on the same Orbital Layer.
While this Ship is below its starting Hull Points, for every 2 Hull Points lost from its starting Hull Points, increase the attack of this weapon by 1.
rules.name: Expel Hazards

rules.description: This Ship’s Mines use the stats of its parent fleet.
rules.name: Acquired Mines

conditions.childName: Rare ships when Rare ship limit reached

characteristics.name: Special
characteristics.$text: Impetuous, Rare, Mind of its Own

rules.description:
This weapon can only be used against targets in base contact.
When you inflict damage with this weapon, you may remove a Spike from this Group, if you do, the defending Group gains a Spike.
rules.name: Thermal Lash

rules.description:
This Ship can be used in any fleet, regardless of faction but does not count towards point spent on M Tonnage Ships when building your fleet. This Ship cannot have an Admiral assigned to it for any reason.
Instead of picking an Order for this Group when it activates, it may in any order; turn in any direction, move up to its Thrust, attack with any number of its weapons gaining a Spike for each additional Weapon System assigned after the first. Each option can only be chosen once per activation.
At the end of this Group's activation, if it did not gain any Spikes, remove a Spike from it.
rules.name: Mind of its Own

conditions.childName: Rare ships when Rare ship limit reached

characteristics.$text: Porter F-2, Reinforced Armour, Monitor, Scrap Hauler, Scratch Bodge Job, Industrial Design
characteristics.name: Special

rules.description: If this Group ends its activation within 1” of a Debris Field, this Group gains a scrap token and cannot gain scrap tokens from that Debris Field for the rest of the game. A Group can have a maximum of 8 scrap tokens at any one time. Any attached Payload ships that have any scrap tokens do not count towards this limit. Whenever another Ship within 6” of a friendly Ship with this rule is destroyed, pick one of those friendly Ships, that Ship gains a scrap token.
rules.name: Scrap Hauler

rules.description:
At the end of this Ship’s activation, you may remove any number of scrap tokens and choose one of the following:
Scrappy Plating: One friendly Ship within 6” recovers lost Hull points equal to the amount of scrap tokens removed.
Bodge Repairs: Remove a crippling effect from a friendly Ship within 6” for each scrap token removed.
rules.name: Scratch Bodge Job

rules.description: This weapon can only be used against targets in base contact.
rules.name: Colossal Salvage Cutter

characteristics.$text: Payload F-1, Vectored, Scrap Collection, Unload, Industrial Design
characteristics.name: Special

rules.description: If this Ship ends its activation within 1” of a Debris Field, this Ship gains a scrap token and cannot gain scrap tokens from that Debris Field for the rest of the game. A Ship with this rule can have a maximum of 3 scrap tokens at any one time. Whenever another Ship within 6” of a friendly Ship with this rule is destroyed, pick one of those friendly Ships, that Ship gains a scrap token.
rules.name: Scrap Collection

rules.description: When you attach this Ship to a Porter Ship, you may have the Porter Ship gain all of this Ship’s scrap tokens.
rules.name: Unload

rules.description: This weapon can only be used against targets in base contact.
rules.name: Sawblade Prow

rules.description: At the start of this Ship’s activation, remove two Spikes from it.
rules.name: Expansive Radiator Systems

rules.description: When this weapon successfully inflicts any amount of damage against a City, place a Mutant Fauna token on that Dropsite. Mutant Fauna tokens are not Battalions and cannot control or contest a Dropsite. When any player deploys any number of Battalions to that Dropsite, if that Dropsite has any Mutant Fauna tokens, those Battalions are only placed on a roll of a 5+. If any Battalions are not placed this way, remove a Mutant Fauna token from that Dropsite. If a Dropsite starts a round with a Mutant Fauna token, remove that token at the end of the round.
rules.name: Genesis Spikes

sharedRules.description: If this Ship is on General Quarters and in base contact with another Ship (friendly or enemy) you may have it Tug that Ship instead of moving normally. If you do, this Ship may turn as normal but only moves up to 3”. The other Ship is then moved the same distance in the same direction, retaining its original facing. Ships can only be tugged this way up to a maximum of 6” each round.
sharedRules.name: Tugging Along

sharedRules.description: This weapon can only be used against targets in base contact. After completing an attack with this weapon, remove this Ship from the table. It counts as destroyed at the end of the game.
sharedRules.name: Drag to Hell

sharedRules.description:
This Ship starts the game with 5 wares tokens.
At the start of each round, if you control this Ship, you may spend a number of wares tokens on one of the following effects until the end of the round:
Defence Harmonics - 2 Tokens: Friendly Groups within 6” improve their Energy and Kinetic saves by 1, to a maximum of a 3+.
Energy Dissipators - 1 Tokens: Friendly Groups within 9” count as having 2 fewer Spikes.
Guardian Schoal - 1 Token: Friendly Assets within 9” cannot be the target of enemy weapons with the Anti Wing special rule
sharedRules.name: Purchased Power

sharedRules.description: When taken as part of your fleet, this Ship starts the game with 2 friendly Battalions on it. When any number of enemy Battalions are removed due to Boarding Actions or Battalion Combat on a Space Station within 6” of this Ship, place a single friendly Battalion on this Ship. This Ship’s Boarding Pods and Drop Pods can only be used while it has friendly Battalions on it and each Boarding Pod or Drop Pod launched causes one friendly Battalion on this Ship to be removed.
sharedRules.name: Penal Legions

sharedRules.description: Improve this Group’s Backup save by 2 when rolling to save hits due to Debris Fields.
sharedRules.name: Industrial Design
Space Trucker
sharedRules.description: This Ship’s Hangar Deployable Feature can only be deployed to Space Stations (of any type).
